label: GO after an unrewarded common a2->S2 trial, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass; never at D1 or D2) and almost only when the previous trial was unrewarded (99.5% of mass) and was a2 reaching S2 through the common transition (prev_action==2 for 82% of mass; the other 18% is on the first trial of the window, where the previous trial is not in the window; prev_action==1 or prev_common==0 hold about 0.1%). It is also strongly gated by time in the episode: rate is highest in trials 1-9, falls off steadily, and is exactly zero from trial 50 on (the threshold of 40 trades recall for precision; <50 gives P 0.59 / R 0.81, <30 gives P 0.85 / R 0.65). Active steps go with the model choosing a2 (89% of mass, choice logit about -4 to -9) and a mid-high value (7.5-8.1), so it is not a switch signal. Uses only observed variables. The predicate misses the first trial in each window (previous trial not in the window), and the episode-time cutoff is a soft proxy for whatever slowly drifting state really gates it, so the description is incomplete. Reward and transition of the previous trial were not checked as magnitude modulators beyond on/off; the top windows are early-episode GOs after unrewarded a2->S2c.
